items.title: Add hirerubydevs.com : currently 800+ remote ruby on rails jobs, highest of any rails platforms so far.
items.description:
Quite a new platform but lists really great opportunities in Ruby and rails which updates very frequenty, this deserves to be shared across Ruby community.

Link: https://hirerubydevs.com/remote-ruby-on-rails-jobs

items.title: Add Growtoria — free business tools & calculators for remote workers
items.description:
Hi, thanks for this list! Suggesting an addition under **Tools**:

[Growtoria](https://growtoria.com) - Free invoicing, quotes/estimates, and business calculators (profit-margin, ROI, break-even, day-rate) for remote freelancers & small teams. No signup.
